text: Based on the evidence from NASA's FIRMS, there were no thermal anomaly detections recorded within the property from September 26, 2026, to October 26, 2026. All sensors (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS) covered the entire period and the whole asset boundary. However, this does not guarantee that no small, short, or cool fires occurred, as they might not have been detected. It also doesn't provide information about burned areas or the cause of any changes.
